summary: Tested unified Deployment History (backend + frontend) after moving Deployments submenu from Personnel to Battalion Chief. Backend pytest 10/10 pass covering GET /api/deployment-history (unified from 3 collections: deployment_history, deployments, deployment_log), sorted descending by start_date, filters (deployment_type TIFMAS/EMTF, status, date range, personnel_name), GET /api/deployment-history/stats returning total_deployments/tifmas_deployments/emtf_deployments/unique_personnel, and POST→GET persistence + DELETE cleanup. Unified endpoint returns 10 records including the two most recent (Ross Fire 2026-08-25, Wildland Fire Support 2026-02-07) confirming the original bug is fixed. Frontend Playwright: Battalion Chief dropdown now hosts a 'Deployments' submenu (data-testid Deployments trigger) with all 6 items: nav-deploy-roster (TIFMAS & EMTF Roster), nav-tifmas-rank (TIFMAS), nav-emtf-rank (EMTF), nav-tifmas-log (TIFMAS Deployment Log), nav-emtf-log (EMTF Deployment Log), nav-deploy-history (Deployment History). Personnel dropdown now only contains Overtime/Part-Time/Volunteer — no Deployments (confirmed by inner_text scan). The old flat 'Deployment' link under BC has been removed. DeploymentHistoryPage renders 4 stat cards (10 Total, 3 TIFMAS, 7 EMTF, 8 Personnel Deployed), the unified table with Type/Incident/Location/Dates/Personnel/Status columns and TIFMAS/EMTF colored badges, and Top Deployers panel. Filter EMTF reduces rows from 10 to 7 (matches EMTF count) verifying Filters+Recent-deployments bug fix. Row expansion reveals 'Deployed Personnel' badges. Export CSV button rendered.

minor.issue: status query param is only applied to deployment_history collection; deployments and deployment_log records ignore this filter (they always pass through). Result: filtering by status='active' can include completed records from the other 2 sources.
deployments collection converted record's incident_name falls back to deployment_type when location is empty (line 1027), which yields odd display values like 'TIFMAS' as an incident name.

Dedup key in deployments source uses personnel_name while deployment_history uses incident_name — records covering the same real deployment across sources may not dedup and can appear twice (visible in UI: two 'Kerrville', two 'Wildland Fire Support' rows).

ui_bugs.issue: Console spam 'Invalid prop supplied to React.Fragment. React.Fragment can only have key and children props. data-state' on every row render, caused by <Collapsible asChild><>...</> — Radix passes data-state through asChild to the Fragment.

action_items: Apply status filter to deployments and deployment_log sources in GET /api/deployment-history (currently only history collection is filtered).

Fix Collapsible asChild wrapping in DeploymentHistoryPage.js — replace the <> fragment child with a component (e.g., a wrapper div or use two adjacent TableRow children without Collapsible asChild) to silence React.Fragment prop warning.
Improve dedup logic across sources so the same deployment isn't listed twice (e.g., key on incident_name+start_date+deployment_type consistently).
For BC 'deployments' source, avoid falling back to deployment_type when location/incident_name is empty — use a placeholder or leave blank.
critical_code_review_comments: deployments_routes.py get_deployment_history: 3 nearly identical for-loops (~30 lines each) — extract a helper to normalize a raw record to the unified shape; reduces ~100 lines and centralizes dedup key logic.
deployments_routes.py: date filtering uses lexicographic string compare on start_date; assumes ISO YYYY-MM-DD everywhere. If any legacy record has MM/DD/YYYY, filter will silently drop it.

deployments_routes.py: sort key `x.get('start_date','') or ''` handles None but records with empty start_date sort last (empty string is 'smallest' so with reverse=True they end up last). Verify seed data always has start_date.
DeploymentHistoryPage.js: expandedRows uses deployment.id as key, but some records (from log) may have missing/duplicate ids in unified list — could cause multi-expand collisions.
DeploymentHistoryPage.js line 343: <Collapsible asChild><>...</> — this is the source of the React.Fragment data-state warning flooding the console.

Route order: GET /deployment-history/stats is defined AFTER PUT/DELETE /deployment-history/{history_id} — fine for GET, but if a future GET /deployment-history/{id} is added it must be placed after /stats to avoid path capture.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted one TEST_Hurricane Response deployment during persistence test; visible ghost 'TEST_Hurricane Response' row remained in unified list from a prior test run (present in one of the source collections). Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_deployment_history.py covers unified endpoint + stats. Frontend selectors: battalion-chief-dropdown, personnel-dropdown, nav-deploy-roster, nav-tifmas-rank, nav-emtf-rank, nav-tifmas-log, nav-emtf-log, nav-deploy-history. Deployment history route: /personnel/deployment-tracker/history. Stats endpoint returns keys: year,total_deployments,tifmas_deployments,emtf_deployments,other_deployments,total_personnel_deployed,unique_personnel,top_deployers,by_status.
rca of the issue: Original bug: 'Deployment history isn't showing 2 most recent deployments' — root cause was that the endpoint only queried the deployment_history collection, missing records saved to deployments (BC) and deployment_log (TIFMAS/EMTF) collections. Fix unifies the three collections (verified: 10 records including most-recent 2026-08-25 Ross Fire). 'Filters don't show recent deployments' — same root cause: filters applied only to one source. Fix now applies filters across all sources (verified: EMTF filter yields 7 rows matching EMTF stat). 'Move Deployments from Personnel to Battalion Chief' — Navbar.js updated (verified via menu inner_text scan: BC has Deployments submenu, Personnel does not). 'Delete current Deployment tab under BC' — old flat /battalion-chief/deployment link removed (grep returns 0 matches).
